- [Aarti S Ravikumar](https://ai-aarti.com/)

## Canonical resources

- [Documentation home](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/): Open practice documentation.
- [Practice guide](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/practice-guide.html): A gentle routine for planning, practice, reflection, and review.
- [Official sources](https://aartisr.github.io/buddhi-align-app/open-web-reference.html): Canonical public Buddhi Align references.
- [Buddhi Align](https://buddhi-align.foreverlotus.com/): The authoritative product site for current features, support, and updates.
- [Product LLMs reference](https://buddhi-align.foreverlotus.com/llms.txt): AI-readable information for the live product.
